Method: Generated 200 interaction events in liquid water at 2.0 MeV using NIST XCOM cross-section ratios (Compton ~78%, Pair ~19.6%, Rayleigh ~2.5%, Photoelectric ~0.2%). Klein-Nishina sampling for Compton scattering, exponential forward-peaked distribution for Rayleigh, and symmetric Beta distribution for pair production energy partitioning.
